basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old gamer and tech enthusiast from Melbourne, Australia. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me flexible hours to indulge in my interests. I'm a night owl, typically online during late evenings to early mornings, often catching up on gaming or exploring new tech trends. I'm single and enjoy connecting with like-minded individuals over shared interests, especially in gaming and politics. I love strategy games and am currently hooked on Minecraft on the Switch. I dislike negativity and heated arguments online and prefer constructive discussions. My heart is set on finding gaming buddies in the EST timezone due to my odd hours.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong interest in technology and gaming, which I've developed through years of self-teaching and exploring online resources. My work as a graphic designer has given me a keen eye for visual aesthetics and an appreciation for game design. Additionally, I follow politics closely, both in Australia and the UK, to stay informed and engage in meaningful discussions.
